validation.native_counter_policy: Native saves persist PCG state/increment words; diagnostic draw counters reset on restore. Redraw/locale same-phase comparisons include all counters. No cross-process diagnostic-counter persistence is claimed.

memory.measurement_policy: Sampled process-tree peaks are lower bounds; shared RSS can be counted repeatedly. No blanket hold or arbitrary 4GB gate.
memory.original_asyncify_issue: Historical 12–13GB instantiation allocation; retained for diagnosis, rejected before Worker creation by ordinary frontend route.
memory.mitigation: Native Wasm exceptions plus JSPI passed actual current native/browser gates; previous JavaScript-EH JSPI constructor SuspendError remains historical.

corresponding_source.checks: Both installed --check branches independently passed; new --build/--repack branches not executed. Immutable executed helpers retained under audit.
corresponding_source.availability: Local filesystem source and notices retained. The localhost asset server is not a source-download endpoint.

preview.stop: Check process.json PID and creation timestamp before stopping this owned server.

remaining: Whole-game Japanese source-origin coverage is incomplete: remaining startup, HUD, menus, dynamic known/unknown names, plural forms, help, settings, errors and endings still contain English.
Registered catalogs have 391 IDs per locale, but one of the 51 native startup IDs is connected. The 45 canned IDs are a copied observer feed; canonical controls/Lua still retain English.
Typed dynamic ActorLabel, ItemLabel, Quantity, CommandRef and RichText schemas must be versioned before broad dynamic text migration; the current canned protocol is parameter-free.
Semantic observation history is bounded/transient and not persisted with native save bytes. Versioned semantic-history checkpoints are unfinished.
Native text-context/IME handling and complete mobile command entry are unfinished. Native session language is pinned; only the frontend/copied feed switches languages live.
Controlled WIZARD combat/branch/death/victory gates do not establish an unassisted full playthrough or exhaustive optional-mode reachability.
390px desktop Chrome emulation was tested; physical mobile-device verification remains open.
The portable recipes passed read-only preflight; their new build/repack branches have not been executed. Actual current outputs came from the retained exact executed helpers.

Controlled flow receipts pin native build/source but did not record historical per-flow Worker/core-debug hashes. Current host files match saved current protocol hashes; no missing historical host hash is inferred.
